neighbours.label: ' name' in 'his/her name was', introducing a person's name in a story
fire: A stranger knocked on our door that night. His name was Daniel.
The new teacher arrived in September; her name was Mrs. Patel.
There was once a poor fisherman, and his name was Ivan.
I sat next to an old man on the train. His name was George.
A girl in my class always helped me, and her name was Lucy.
The village had one doctor. His name was Dr. Abara.
We adopted a stray cat last winter; her name is Mittens.
In 1890 a young engineer came to town. His name was Karl.
quiet: A stranger knocked on our door that night. He was soaked from the rain.
The new teacher arrived in September; she taught us maths.
There was once a poor fisherman who lived by the sea.
I sat next to an old man on the train. He was reading a paper.
A girl in my class always helped me with my homework.
The village had one doctor who worked every day.
We adopted a stray cat last winter; she sleeps on the sofa.
In 1890 a young engineer came to town to build the bridge.

notes: Probe: 'His name was Elias' 1.0, 'his name was Tom' 0.82, 'name it something' 0.49, 'was called' 0.12.
